rationale: Both existing Workflows specs (workflows-crud.spec.js, workflows-negative.spec.js) are disabled by the dev's own diff — their beforeEach now calls test.skip(true, 'Workflows feature under rework'). They target the v1 builder (Alert Trigger pre-placed, results dock, inline-edit name/description, selectors like workflow-editor-name-trigger/input/value, workflows-list-page) which the rework replaced wholesale. The v1 page object (workflowsPage.js) selectors are obsolete: the rework renames the editor name field to workflow-editor-name (single OInlineEdit, no -trigger/-input/-value suffix), the list table to workflow-list-table, adds a Save-as-Draft/Publish split (workflow-editor-save-draft/workflow-editor-publish), an empty-canvas start scaffold (workflow-flow-start-trigger/action), a node detail view (workflow-ndv-*), and replaces the results dock with a dedicated WorkflowRuns/WorkflowRunsPanel surface (workflow-runs-*). Extending or appending to the skipped v1 specs would mean rewriting both files and un-skipping them; a single new spec named per run-context (workflows-canvas.spec.js) is cleaner. needs_registration=true because the OSS ci_matrix.json has no Workflows shard (the v1 specs were registered only in the enterprise ci_matrix.ent.json overlay); the Engineer must add a Workflows shard to tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix.json.
area_notes: Feature is Workflows-only (canvas, node drawer, runs panel). No secondary feature area spans out of scope; the backend diffs (src/core/src/workflows/mod.rs, batch_execution.rs, alerts scheduler) are all in service of the same Workflows feature and are covered by the test-run / runs-view scenarios.
